fields.value: No automatic fixed-term renewal is stated; if the Joint Venture continues after expiry without an express new agreement, it continues at will with rights and duties remaining the same so far as consistent.

quotes.text:
Where the Joint Venture is entered for a fixed
term and the Joint Venture continues after the expiration of that
term then in the absence of an express new agreement, the rights
and duties of the Participants remain the same as they were at the
expiration of that term so far as those terms are consistent with a
Joint Venture at will.

ambiguities: The Purpose clause does not call this a renewal and makes continuation depend on the Joint Venture continuing after the fixed term expires.

fields.value: Any Participant may voluntarily withdraw at any time on at least Thirty (30) business days' written notice; voluntary withdrawal dissolves the Joint Venture.

quotes.text:
Any Participant will have the right to voluntarily withdraw from
the Joint Venture at any time. Written notice of intention to
withdraw must be served in writing upon the remaining Participants
at least Thirty (30) business days prior to the withdrawal date.

T h e v o l u n t a r y w i t h d r a w a l o f a P a r t i c i p a n t w i l l r e s u l t i n t h e
dissolution of the Joint Venture.

ambiguities: The Voluntary Withdrawal of a Participant clause uses “business days,” but the agreement does not define business days or a holiday calendar.

fields.value: Involuntary withdrawal, causing dissolution, applies for events including breach of fiduciary duties, criminal conviction, expulsion, operation of law/bankruptcy and reputational disrepute; expulsion includes willful or persistent material breach of the Agreement or duties owed.

quotes.text:
Events resulting in the involuntary withdrawal of a Participant from
the Joint Venture will include, but not be limited to: death of a
Participant; Participant mental incapacity; Participant disability
preventing reasonable participation in the Joint Venture; Participant
incompetence; breach of fiduciary duties by a Participant; criminal
conviction of a Participant; Expulsion of a Participant; Operation of
Law against a Participant; or any act or omission of a Participant
that can reasonably be expected to bring the business or societal
reputation of the Joint Venture into disrepute.

The involuntary withdrawal of a Participant will result in the
dissolution of the Joint Venture.

"Operation of Law" means rights or duties that are cast upon a
party by the law, without any act or agreement on the part of
the individual including, but not limited to, an assignment for
the benefit of creditors, a divorce, or a bankruptcy.

fields.value: Mutual non-compete/conflict covenant: no Participant may directly or indirectly engage in competitive or direct-conflict business without unanimous written consent of the remaining Participants; apparent conflicts must be disclosed.

quotes.text:
No Participant will engage in any business, venture or transaction,
whether directly or indirectly, that might be competitive with the
business of the Joint Venture or that would be in direct conflict of
interest to the Joint Venture without the unanimous written consent
of the remaining Participants. Any and all businesses, ventures or
transactions with any appearance of conflict of interest must be
fully disclosed to all other Participants. Failure to comply with any of
the terms of this clause will be deemed an Involuntary Withdrawal of
the offending Participant and may be treated accordingly by the
remaining Participants.

The purpose of the Joint Venture will be: Manufacturing and Selling
Health Related products.

Where the Joint Venture is entered for a fixed
term and the Joint Venture continues after the expiration of that
term then in the absence of an express new agreement, the rights
and duties of the Participants remain the same as they were at the
expiration of that term so far as those terms are consistent with a
Joint Venture at will.

ambiguities: The Duty of Loyalty clause does not state a geographic territory.
The restriction is tied to activities that “might be competitive with the business of the Joint Venture” or in direct conflict, and the clause does not further define those phrases.
Duration after 2019-11-30 may continue if the Joint Venture continues after expiry under the Purpose clause.

payments.description: Initial capital contributions by each Participant to the Joint Venture.
payments.conditionNote: Amounts, value of any property, and due dates are only stated as agreed and are not fixed in the document.

quotes.text:
Each of the Participants will contribute to the capital of the Joint
Venture, in cash or property in agreed upon value. All Participants
will contribute their respective Contributions as agreed.

ambiguities: The Capital Contributions clause does not state any fixed contribution amount, currency or due date.

payments.description: Repayment by the Joint Venture of Participant advances in excess of agreed capital contributions, with interest.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only if a Participant advances money; repayment rate and timing are to be determined later by majority vote.

quotes.text:
Any advance of money to the Joint Venture by any Participant in
e x c e s s o f t h e a m o u n t s p r o v i d e d f o r i n t h i s A g r e e m e n t o r
subsequently agreed to as Additional Capital Contribution will be
deemed a debt owed by the Joint Venture and not an increase in
Capital Contribution of the Participant. This liability will be repaid
with interest at rates and times to be determined by a majority of
the Participants within the limits of what is required or permitted in
the Act.

ambiguities: The Additional Capital clause does not state the amount of any advance, the interest rate, or repayment dates.

payments.description: Audit cost borne by the Joint Venture when a Participant requests an audit.
payments.conditionNote: Triggered by an audit request; amount and due date are not fixed.

quotes.text:
Any of the Participants will have the right to request an audit of the
Joint Venture books. The cost of the audit will be borne by the Joint
Venture.

ambiguities: The Audit clause does not state the amount of audit costs or when they must be paid.

payments.description: Chargeback and collection from a Participant of losses caused by acting without required unanimous consent.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only if a violation causes losses; amount and due date are not fixed.

quotes.clauseId: Actions Requiring Unanimous Consent of the Participants
quotes.text:
Any losses incurred as a result of a violation of this section will be
charged to and collected from the individual Participant that acted
without unanimous consent and caused the loss.

ambiguities: The Actions Requiring Unanimous Consent of the Participants clause does not state a fixed amount or payment date for collected losses.

payments.description: Indemnification and hold harmless by the Joint Venture for claims arising out of a Participant's participation in Joint Venture affairs, excluding gross negligence, willful misconduct or breach.
payments.conditionNote: Triggered by covered claims; amount and payment timing depend on the claim.

quotes.text:
All Participants will be indemnified and held harmless by the Joint

Venture affairs. A Participant will not be entitled to indemnification

w i l l f u l m i s c o n d u c t o f t h e P a r t i c i p a n t o r t h e b r e a c h b y t h e

ambiguities: The Indemnification clause does not state a monetary limit, procedure or payment date for indemnified claims.

payments.description: On dissolution and liquidation, Joint Venture assets must be applied to selling costs and expenses, creditor liabilities, debt obligations to current Participants, and then distributions to Participants; Participants share remaining assets or liabilities by capital contribution proportions.
payments.conditionNote: Triggered by dissolution and liquidation; amounts depend on assets, liabilities, costs and capital contribution proportions.

quotes.clauseId: Distribution of Property on Dissolution of Joint Venture
quotes.text:
In the event of the dissolution of the Joint Venture, each Participant
will share in any remaining assets or liabilities of the Joint Venture
in proportion to the Participants' Capital Contributions inclusive of
any Additional Capital Contributions (the "Dissolution Distribution").

quotes.clauseId: Distribution of Property on Dissolution of Joint Venture
quotes.text:
Upon Dissolution of the Joint Venture and liquidation of Joint
Venture Property, and after payment of all selling costs and
expenses, the liquidator will distribute the Joint Venture assets to
the following groups according to the following order of priority:
in satisfaction of liabilities to creditors except Joint Venture
obligations to current Participants;
in satisfaction of Joint Venture debt obligations to current
Participants; and then
to the Participants according to the Dissolution Distribution
described above.

ambiguities: The Distribution of Property on Dissolution of Joint Venture clause does not state fixed amounts, currencies or dates; payment depends on dissolution, liquidation results and capital contribution proportions.

payments.description: Participants must account to the Joint Venture for benefits derived without consent from Joint Venture transactions or use of Joint Venture property, name or business connection.
payments.conditionNote: Triggered by an unauthorized benefit; amount, currency and payment timing are not fixed, and the benefit may be non-cash.

quotes.clauseId: Duty of Accountability for Private Profits
quotes.text:
Each Participant must account to the Joint Venture for any benefit
derived by that Participant without the consent of the other
Participants from any transaction concerning the Joint Venture or
any use by that Participant of the Joint Venture property, name or
b u s i n e s s c o n n e c t i o n .

ambiguities: The Duty of Accountability for Private Profits clause does not state a fixed amount or date, and “any benefit” may include non-cash benefits.
